## Phase 1 — Package Updates

### T1.1 — Update core MAF package

**File:** `src/<Project>/<Project>.csproj`

```xml
<!-- BEFORE -->
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Agents.AI" Version="<old>" />

<!-- AFTER -->
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Agents.AI" Version="1.3.0" />
```

### T1.2 — Add source generator package

**File:** `src/<Project>/<Project>.csproj`

```xml
<!-- ADD (new — required for executor source generation) -->
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Agents.AI.Workflows.Generators" Version="1.3.0">
  <PrivateAssets>all</PrivateAssets>
  <IncludeAssets>runtime; build; native; contentfiles; analyzers; buildtransitive</IncludeAssets>
</PackageReference>
```

Also add to the same `<PropertyGroup>`:
```xml
<EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>true</EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>
```

## Phase 3 — Instructions Placement

### T3.1 — Move Instructions inside ChatOptions

**File:** `<file path>`

```csharp

{
    Instructions = "You are...",
    Tools = [tool1, tool2]
};

// AFTER

{
    ChatOptions = new ChatOptions
    {
        Instructions = "You are...",
        Tools = [tool1, tool2]
    }
};
```

## Phase 4 — Executor Migration

### T4.1 — Migrate `<ExecutorClassName>`

**File:** `<file path>`

```csharp
// BEFORE
public class <ExecutorClassName> : ReflectingExecutor<<InputType>>
{
    public async Task<<OutputType>> HandleAsync(<InputType> input) { ... }
}

// AFTER
public sealed partial class <ExecutorClassName> : Executor
{
    [MessageHandler]
    public async ValueTask<<OutputType>> HandleAsync(<InputType> input, ExecutorContext context) { ... }
}
```

**Guide section:** 9.1

> ⚠️ If this executor is a **fan-out** executor, the return type MUST be `ValueTask<T>` where `T` is the message type broadcast to targets. A `void`/`ValueTask` return silently starves the fan-in barrier.

---

## Phase 5 — Session Migration

### T5.1 — Replace `AgentThread` with `AgentSession`

**File:** `<file path>`

```csharp
// BEFORE
var thread = agent.GetNewThread();
var response = await agent.RunAsync(input, thread);

// AFTER
var session = await agent.CreateSessionAsync(cancellationToken);
var response = await agent.RunAsync(input, session);
```

**Guide section:** 6

---

## Phase 6 — Response Deserialization

### T6.1 — Replace `AgentResponse.Deserialize<T>()`

**File:** `<file path>`

```csharp
// BEFORE
var response = await agent.RunAsync(input);
var result = response.Deserialize<MyType>();

// AFTER
var response = await ((ChatClientAgent)agent).RunAsync<MyType>(input, session);
var result = response.Result;
```

**Guide section:** 11

## Phase 10 — Verification Grep Checks

Run these after all migration tasks complete. Every command must return **zero matches**.

```powershell
# Old executor patterns
Select-String -Path "src/**/*.cs" -Pattern "ReflectingExecutor|IMessageHandler<" -Recurse
Select-String -Path "src/**/*.cs" -Pattern "\[StreamsMessage\]|\[YieldsMessage\]" -Recurse

# Old session patterns
Select-String -Path "src/**/*.cs" -Pattern "AgentThread|GetNewThread" -Recurse

# Old response patterns
Select-String -Path "src/**/*.cs" -Pattern "\.Deserialize<" -Recurse

# Old streaming patterns
Select-String -Path "src/**/*.cs" -Pattern "\.StreamAsync\(\)" -Recurse

# Old event names
Select-String -Path "src/**/*.cs" -Pattern "AgentRunUpdateEvent" -Recurse

# Old A2A patterns
Select-String -Path "src/**/*.cs" -Pattern "AIAgentExtensions|app\.MapA2A\b" -Recurse

# CS0618 warnings
dotnet build 2>&1 | Select-String "warning CS0618"
```

## Risk Register

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Fan-out handler returns void — fan-in starves silently | High | `maf-fan-out-validator` skill mandatory in Phase 3 |
| Wrong `AddFanInBarrierEdge` overload — topology reversed | High | `cs0618-hunter` mandatory in Phase 3 |
| DevUI removed in 1.3.0 — unguarded references break build | Medium | T9.x tasks guard with `#if DEVUI_ENABLED` |
| Source generator not installed — executor class doesn't compile | Medium | T1.2 adds Generators package |
| `Instructions` at wrong level — CS0117 since MAF 1.0 (pre-1.0 previews only) | Low | `maf-constraints.instructions.md` always loaded |
